provenance.name: custom open-frame design in cad/yakrobot-4wd.scad
provenance.geometry.wheelbase_m: design: TT axles at x = +/-65 mm (axle_x in yakrobot-4wd.scad)
provenance.geometry.track_m: design: motor faces at +/-47 mm + 8 mm shaft + 13 mm half wheel = +/-68 mm
provenance.physics.mass_kg: provisional estimate: ~170 g printed PLA + 4 TT motors 120 g + 2x18650 and holder 110 g + electronics 40 g + wheels 100 g
provenance.limits.topSpeed_mps: provisional: TT 1:48 ~200 rpm under load x pi x 65 mm
provenance.limits.turnRate_radps: provisional: 6.5 rad/s reference TT rover spin rate scaled by the speed ratio (x 0.68 / 0.9)
provenance.drive.minDuty: provisional: sim-side dead-zone compensation; replace with the Nano firmware's PWM floor
provenance.motor.timeConstant_s: provisional: typical TT motor + wheel spin-up
provenance.motor.deadZone: provisional: TT motors usually stall below ~20% PWM
provenance.motor.stallTorque_Nm: provisional: TT 1:48 motor on 2S (7.4 V) through DRV8833, ~1.2 kg.cm stall
provenance.physics.wheelMass_kg: stock TT wheel with rubber tyre, ~25 g
provenance.physics.tyreFriction: provisional: knobbly rubber on smooth floor; tuned so a full-stick spin lands near limits.turnRate in MuJoCo
provenance.physics.armature_kgm2: provisional: motor rotor inertia x 48^2 gear ratio, reflected to the wheel
